rules.title: package directory exists and is readable
a YAML parser is available for a .yaml artifact
the contract-v1 manifest schema loads and the checker applies every keyword it uses
manifest present and parses to a mapping
spec_version present, MAJOR.MINOR, major supported
identity block complete (id, name, version, owner, domain, modality, purpose)
inputs declared and well formed (float inputs state units; a range is [min, max], min < max)
outputs declared and well formed (float outputs state units)
no duplicate input or output names
every output is covered by an uncertainty.per_output block; uncertainty.form none (from contract 1.1) declares no block and no calibration
invocation block complete and protocol is supported
model_card path declared, inside the package, and the file exists
validation.report path declared, inside the package, and the file exists
provenance block present
provenance.artifacts entries well formed (a path inside the package, a role, a sha256, an integer byte count)
every declared artifact exists and its sha256 matches the file on disk
provenance.dataset carries a well formed sha256
provenance.code carries repo and commit
provenance.environment names the interpreter
a declared provenance.signature is {format: oms, path} naming a file in the package that is not a pinned artifact (the checker verifies no signature)
the manifest conforms to the contract-v1 manifest schema (required keys, types, enumerations, patterns, bounds)
a type: field output declares its field block (kind, units, support, media_type) from contract 1.1, and a declared block is complete and sits on a field output
a declared licence block names the model, the weights and the training data, each by an SPDX license expression with its text or URL, or by NOASSERTION with a note
a package declaring contract 1.1 or later declares a licence block
model card parses with a flat scalar front-matter
card front-matter identity matches the manifest
the eleven required card sections are present, first, in order
no required card section is a stub
the uncertainty section states a method and a number, or, under uncertainty.form none, that the model reports no uncertainty
extra H2 sections use reserved names
validation report parses and declares its identity
validation report identity (model_id, model_version, spec_version) matches the manifest
validation report dataset hash matches the manifest provenance
every ladder key is present
every check declares a known status
a PASS carries a numeric measurement and a numeric threshold
NOT_APPLICABLE states a reason
the declared overall verdict matches the recomputed one
B4 conservation is measured, not declared (a NOT_RUN check declares applicable: true and carries no measurement)
A3 uq_calibration reports nominal, empirical coverage, n and method
A5 reproducibility declares a determinism class and a tolerance (bitwise means tolerance 0, from contract 1.1)
comparators are well formed, and every PASS or FAIL check has one from contract 1.1
each measured check's declared status agrees with the status its comparators give

check --smoke: the entrypoint answers each example, and a batch of them where batch is supported, in the stdio_json frame: exit 0 within its timeout, a frame per row, every declared output and uncertainty key (and, from contract 1.1, status and run_id)
check --smoke: the smoke test could run (examples declared, the entrypoint verified and launchable here)
check --smoke: every artifact reference an answer carries, and every declared field and *_artifact value, names a file in the run's working directory with its declared bytes, sha256 and media type
